facts.text: Sam expressed gratitude to Evan for the healthy snack suggestion and mentioned they would try the snacks.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Evan! I'll give these a try. They look yum. Your help means a lot to me.
Awesome! Always on the lookout for healthy snacks, thanks for the tip!

facts.text: Sam mentioned experiencing issues with the self-checkout at the store again, describing it as an ongoing annoyance.

evidence.quote: I went to the store again and, unsurprisingly, had issues with the self-checkout. It's becoming a regular annoyance.

facts.text: Evan expressed surprise at Sam's experience with the self-checkout, stating they had never had any issues with it.

evidence.quote: That's very strange, I've never had a problem with it once!

facts.text: Sam humorously suggested that they might attract self-checkout issues and offered to accompany Evan to the store if needed.

evidence.quote: Apparently I attract that to me, if you ever want to be in that situation, call me at the store with you!
